summary: How to send Automancer an enquiry. Every route reaches the same person, Waseem. Email is the one an agent can complete on its own; the web form needs a person in a browser.

routes.detail: A plain email reaches the same human the form does. Waseem replies by email to the address it came from.

requires: A Cloudflare Turnstile browser security check
routes.detail: Built for a person in a browser. The intake service refuses a submission without a passed security check, and only accepts one sent from the form on automancer.uk. An agent cannot complete it and should not try to get round the check: use email.
A voicemail line: leave a message and it reaches Waseem, same as the form. No switchboard, no bot.

fields.label: What's eating your week?
fields.example: The boring, repetitive, expensive stuff. What takes up too much of your team's time?

fields.label: Roughly how big is your team?

prefill.detail: Opening /contact/ with ?service=<value> arrives with that option picked; the visitor can change it. Each service button on the site links this way. An unknown value picks nothing.

combinedMessage.detail: The form sends these four as one message: “Interested in: …” with the chosen option's label when one is picked, then the answer to “What's eating your week?”, then “Team size: …” and “Also: …” when they are given. Together they must fit in 5,000 characters.

email.subject: Enquiry
email.body:
Your name

Business name (optional)

What are you interested in? (optional) One of: Automation Opportunity Audit, Workflow Sprint, System / Agent Build, AI Ops Partner, Not sure yet.

What's eating your week?

Roughly how big is your team? (optional)

Anything else we should know? (optional)
email.detail: A starting point that asks what the form asks. The form needs a name and what's eating your week; the rest is optional. The reply goes to the address the email is sent from.

responsePromise: We promise a meeting within one week of first contact.

whatHappensNext.detail: It lands in the same project system our AI agents run — the one we built and use every day. Nothing gets lost, nothing sits ignored in an inbox.
No auto-responder pretending to be a person. An actual human reads what you wrote and works out how we can help.

whatHappensNext.step: You get a personal email back
whatHappensNext.detail: From Waseem, to arrange a proper conversation — and we'll have that meeting within one week of you getting in touch.
Usually that means an Automation Audit, but if a quick pointer is all you need, we'll happily give you that too.
